summary: **Earth System Trend Detective** is an AI-powered environmental monitoring and climate analytics platform designed to track and analyze real-time changes in Earth's environment. The project integrates satellite intelligence, geospatial mapping, and live environmental data from sources such as NASA, NOAA, Open-Meteo, USGS, and Copernicus Sentinel. It provides insights into weather conditions, air quality, wildfires, and environmental trends through interactive maps and analytics. AI-powered features help users detect environmental patterns and generate environmental impact reports. The platform addresses the challenge of accessing and understanding environmental data from multiple sources by bringing everything into one centralized system. It aims to support better environmental awareness, data-driven decisions, and a deeper understanding of climate change and Earth's changing systems.
details:
Earth System Trend Detective

1. What does the project do and how does it work?

Earth System Trend Detective is an AI-powered environmental monitoring and climate analytics platform. It collects environmental information from multiple sources, including NASA, NOAA, Open-Meteo, USGS, Copernicus Sentinel, and Global Forest Watch. It combines satellite intelligence, geospatial mapping, and environmental data to monitor changes in Earth's systems, including weather, wildfires, air quality, and climate trends. It uses AI integration to analyze environmental information and generate environmental impact reports.

2. What benefits does it have?

The platform brings environmental information from different sources into one centralized system. It helps users monitor environmental conditions, understand climate trends, identify potential environmental risks, and access useful information through maps, analytics, and AI-generated reports.

3. What is the intended impact of the project?

The main goal is to increase environmental awareness and support better data-driven decisions. It aims to help people understand environmental changes, monitor Earth's systems, and recognize the importance of protecting our planet.

4. What tools, programming languages, and software were used?

The project was developed using:

  • Frontend: React and Vite.
  • Backend: Node.js and Express.js.
  • Programming: JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Package Management: npm.
  • Database: PostgreSQL (optional).
  • Mapping: Google Maps Platform.
  • AI Integration: OpenRouter and Google Gemini.
  • Environmental Data Sources: NASA, NOAA, Open-Meteo, USGS, Copernicus Sentinel, and Global Forest Watch.
  • Development Environment: Visual Studio Code.

5. How is the project creative and innovative?

The creativity of this project comes from combining artificial intelligence, satellite intelligence, real-time environmental feeds, geospatial technology, and climate analytics into a single platform. Instead of checking multiple environmental sources separately, users can access different types of environmental information through one integrated system.

6. What factors did the team consider?

Our team considered data accessibility, environmental monitoring, integration of multiple APIs, AI capabilities, geographical accuracy, user accessibility, system performance, and the importance of providing meaningful environmental insights. We also considered making the platform scalable and supporting optional database storage for persistent watchlists, alerts, and observations.
